description: This file implements the AckSender class, which is responsible for sending acknowledgment events via an IPC client in the Rialto server component. It constructs AckEvent objects, sets their properties, and sends them through the IPC client.

classes.name: AckSender
classes.description: A class responsible for sending acknowledgment events to the IPC client.

methods.name: AckSender
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AckSender with an IPC client.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Creates and sends an AckEvent with the specified id and success status.
